TechCrunch: total raised $397M as of Nov 2017 (includes a 2016 Series D not itemized here, and some secondary). Later 2019/2020 rounds were largely secondary share sales and not counted. PUBLIC: direct listing on the London Stock Exchange 7 Jul 2021, ~£8.75B (~$11B) valuation (Reuters/CNBC).
